reviews.text: Our senior dog deteriorated quickly this morning, and we knew she was ready. I called Falcon Pass, and they so graciously took us in for the euthanasia the same morning even though they were fully booked. We are so grateful for the compassionate staff and excellent service. Thank you. 🤍 …
I love Falcon Pass! We have been bringing our babies here for a while now and they seem to care alot about the pets.

I brought my French bulldog Eli for an appointment, he had an ear infection.
The doctor was very good, we received everything: the prompt attention, tests were done fast and medication was given to us before we left. We like coming here.

I’ve had many dogs and I’ve seen many vets. Dr. Sunderland is the best vet I’ve taken my dogs to, and that’s including the Michigan State Veterinary Hospital. She is so knowledgeable and genuinely cares about your pets healthcare. I can’t say enough good things about her. Thanks Dr. Sunderland!

Our mixed bred poodle has been seeing Kimberly Sutherland since 2011.  We are extremely satisfied with the way she has been treating our Zoey.  She clearly love our dog.
We are impressed by the efficiency and helpfulness of the staff.
Extremely professional, caring, results, treatment, follow-up.
So good! Excellent service!!

Falcon Pass is, and has been, an incredible blessing for our pets!! Doctors Borovik, Sunderland and Norton have shown a level of care and compassion we could only dream of. We feel lucky to be able to bring them to such an amazing practice and are thankful to have them in our community!
Only place I will take my fur babies

Everyone here is super helpful, genuinely kind to our sometimes anxious pets, and all the vets really take their time to talk to you about concerns (yours or theirs). I truly appreciate the Saturday hours, too.

After leaving my vet of more than 30 years due to ownership change of hands 3 times now and now being corporate owned, which has ruined them I hate to say....I was hesitant of changing vets. I currently have 2 dogs and 2 cats. My first appointment to register one of my dogs went without a hitch today.  She was due for her annual parasite screening along with her heartworm test & needed an anal expression. They handled everything perfectly.  I even got the results same day while we were there. The final bill was reasonable.  The front desk staff was friendly and welcoming. And Dr. Norton was warm and knowledgeable. I still have 3 more pets/babies to register, but so far I feel confident and stress free about deciding to switch to Falson Pass Animal Hospital. Also, one of the doctors is the owner. That is so reassuring. When you own the practice, you tend to take better care of it, your staff and your patients. So far, it shows ;). Thank you FPAH!

Nice & sincere vets, but the receptionist who answers the phone is always hit or miss.

I called today (12/22) with concerns of my elderly labrador suffering with diarrhea and panting for the past 48-hours. I’m currently out of town & making flight arrangements to return home ASAP.

In the mean time, I was hoping the clinic could provide medication to my neighbor to alleviate the diarrhea until I’m home.

The front desk employee told me that an appointment is required before any medication is provided. I understand an appointment is needed to know the main cause of continuous diarrhea, but there’s absolutely nothing that can be done in the meantime? …The only solution is for my dog to continuously suffer and become dehydrated?

I wish the front desk employee could have attempted with a temporary solution until I’m back in town.

* UPDATE: my sitter purchased [ Pro-Pectalin ] and it helped my dog through the night.

This clinic is mostly great but Dr. Sunderland is unprofessional, lewd, and obnoxious.  I'd just recommended requesting a doctor other than her to get help with your loved one. She has been forceful and rude on more than one occasion while the other doctors are kind and compassionate. This has been my experience.

I’ve been bringing my three animals here for years, but today’s experience was incredibly disappointing. I stopped in to pick up my dogs’ monthly flea and tick prevention, and the front desk staff told me they couldn’t dispense it because my dog was due for an exam. I explained that I work the rest of the week and that her next dose is due tomorrow, and asked if there was any way they could provide the medication now and I’d bring her in next week. The staff member responded rudely and refused, so I asked to speak with someone else.
When the doctor came out, she repeated the same thing and added that my dog “wouldn’t die” if she went a few days without her medication. When I expressed concern about fleas, suddenly they decided they could give me the medication—as long as I still brought her in.
The entire interaction made me feel like I was being treated as if I’d done something wrong, rather than as a long-time client who cares deeply about their pets. I’m truly disappointed, and I think it’s time to find a vet who treats animals like family and not just as dollar signs.
Great veterinary clinic! They see my personal pets and they have always done the right thing for them. Dr. Borovik listens and gives her recommendations. Happy to have them taking care of my pups!

Dr. Norton performed life saving pyometra surgery on my 15 year old dog and Dr. Sunderland was also extremely helpful with the entire process along with the front desk who were super kind and helpful about getting us in quick and answering all of our questions

Absolutely incredible and so welcoming. 😭 we have had the most emotional week being in Texas from out of town for an extra extended stay that we weren’t anticipating and ended up with our dog sick. It was the cherry on top to the hardest few weeks we’ve had. They treated us like family and our dog got top tier care. I’m so happy to report he is finally doing so much better thanks to these guys!! We’re forever grateful.

I adore and trust Dr. Sunderland. She always takes great care of my fur babies and is very thorough at explaining things to my husband and I. She’s helped my older pitbull through two tumor removals and I will be forever grateful to her. Dr. Norton is also great - she’s only treated my shepherd pup but she was very patient with him as he’s slow to warm up and read his cues well. She also gave us great advice on trainers in the area. The front staff and techs are always warm and welcoming too. Truly could not ask for a better team of people to care for my babies.
Very good followup on Lexi's teeth cleaning, organized
Very pleased with the service our dog received. Everyone was very friendly and professional. The prices weren't bad either.
I have only used them last minute but they are fabulous

It’s OK but the veterinarian is a big baby when she is asked any questions about dog food or health products like she just wants to throw you out be over already. They forget things as well like shots and the tests were overpriced but I was willing to pay for my pets health but I highly recommend not getting that same veterinarian.
She’s just not that nice.
My dogs love the friendly and professional staff at Falcon Pass Animal Hospital. They actually LIKE going to the Vet!

I had to bring my aunt’s dog in on a Saturday due to an issue with its eye, and from start to finish, the experience was incredible. Every single person—from the kind and professional staff who answered the phone to the compassionate and knowledgeable doctor who treated our dog—was absolutely amazing. They were not only informative and thorough, but it was also clear they genuinely cared and wanted to help. I’m from out of state, but if I lived here, this would be the only place I’d take my pets. Thank you for the outstanding care!
They saved my sweet Angel

I can’t thank Dr. Sunderland and the team at Falcon Pass Animal Hospital enough for the incredible care they’ve given to two of my cats.

One of them is a senior I was finally able to trap after years of living on the streets. He came to me with a long list of health problems—severe arthritis, dental disease, bad URI, inflamed gums, and more. Dr. Sunderland has been so patient, compassionate, and thorough in helping us manage his complex care.
His healing journey is still ongoing, but thanks to Dr. Sunderland’s spot-on diagnosis and thoughtful treatment plan, he's finally on track to living the quality life he deserves after all he’s been through.

My other baby is a younger boy that I found almost two years ago. Since he was a kitten, he had been suffering from chronic diarrhea that several other vets failed to properly investigate or diagnose. Dr. Sunderland took the time to dig deeper, run comprehensive tests, and finally figure out the root cause. Because of her, he’s now thriving and finally comfortable for the first time in a long while.

I love my cats deeply, and seeing them play, improve, and regain their health brings me so much happiness. It's such a relief to have a vet I can trust with their well-being. I'm incredibly grateful for the expertise, honesty, and kindness we've experienced at Falcon Pass—Dr. Sunderland truly goes above and beyond.

She truly listened, took every concern seriously, and didn’t miss a thing. Nothing was brushed off—she made sure to investigate each issue thoroughly and provide clear answers. That’s exactly why I was more than willing to drive an hour and a half to bring my cats to her. I knew that by the time I got back home, there’d be no guessing, no Googling—just peace of mind, knowing everything had been carefully examined and addressed.

And as an added bonus, the cost of the procedures for my senior cat was nearly half of what I expected. That kind of fairness and transparency is rare.

I highly recommend Falcon Pass Animal Hospital to anyone looking for real answers and genuine care for their pets.

I had the best experience I've ever had at a Vet.  here. The office and exam room were spotless, with a calming decor. The check in was quick, efficient with cheerful people. The tech was attentive and wrote down all the info I gave her. The most amazing thing was the Vet. She sat down on the floor to talk with my very nervous dog and spent time talking with us while she examined  him. I have never had a Vet spend more than 5 min talking with us. It was wonderful and let me know her as well as let her know us.

Our cat Spot got into with something outside and for his efforts, got a nicely infected bite on his back. We have not been going to Falcon Pass clinic long, but unlike the TLC clinic - ( tlc NOT recommended) these folks are the absolute best in the Clear Lake area! I Highly Recommend them! They care and get Positive results for your fur baby!
Dr. Sunderland and Dr. Borovik are very helpful and knowledgeable.

I trusted this place with my senior for his last year here on earth. They did EVERYTHING right by him, and me. I knew I could count on the dog-tors to be kind, but honest. When my chihuahua crossed the bridge, he was given a release with dignity and respect. I never had any problems here, and should I adopt in future, My next dog will be a patient at this same hospital. I cannot recommend this place enough for the quality care pet parents count on.

The doctors and technicians at Falcon Pass Animal Hospital are outstanding. You can tell that the staff here are knowledgeable, highly skilled, and truly love animals. We've worked with Dr. Borovic and Dr. Norton, both of with whom we've had wonderful experiences. We've been here for a variety of services for our senior dog, including check-ups, teeth cleaning/extraction, and a mass removal. When our dog developed a mass, the staff fit him into Saturday the same week, despite them already having a full schedule. Dr. Norton took the time to explain what was happening and answer all of our questions, scheduled the surgery within 2 weeks, and successfully carried out a challenging procedure to remove his mass with full margins. She gave us clear aftercare instructions and even did a follow-up check-up one week later free of charge. We are infinitely grateful to Falcon Pass Animal Hospital, and are happy to call them our vet!
Wonderful, very informative and compassionate staff.

I was a bit nervous about trying a new vet after going to the same one for over 15 years, but I was pleasantly surprised. They took excellent care of my kitty, and their customer service was outstanding. Their prices are very reasonable, especially for the high-quality care they provide. I’m happy to say I’ve found my new vet!

So pleased with staff and doctors. Scheduled my dog, Rusty, with short notice for possible UTI. Doctor and her Assistant explained all options and did labs, nails. Thank you all so much.  Amazing difference for our office visit.

We've been going here for 3 years with all our pets and have seen all 3 doctors over the course of that time, so I can say that everyone working there is great, friendly, and dedicated to keeping pets healthy and happy. We do usually see Dr. Sunderland, and she always calls back to check in on our pets after they eat random things, get allergic to random things, and other mischief they get into.

I had an emergency situation with my 10-year-old English Mastiff "Hulk" and the staff here quickly scheduled him an appointment.

We had a cancer concern, and the Dr immediately scheduled him for surgery the next day (fully booked but worked Hulk in). The team was very thorough with their explanation of his treatment and after surgery care plan.  I received several follow up calls to check on Hulk directly from the Dr, along with the best new ever - a negative cancer lab results….phew!!

My family thanks you for helping our Hulk out so quickly!
We love Falcon Pass Animal Hospital!
Clear, reliable advice. These vets will talk all of the options and risks with you.

This is the best vet place! All of the vets are so nice and considerate of both the owners and the animals. They are reasonable with their pricing. And they are always so on top of everything. The entire staff is friendly and inviting. I will never go to another place for any of my animals. 11/10.

Dr Sunderland and Dr Borovik took care of my beloved Axel in his final days and the caring and kindness from  all of the staff at this clinic was truly amazing. I would highly recommend this facility.
